description: This is a unit test class for the Order entity, verifying the correctness of the Total() method with different order scenarios.

classes.name: OrderTotal
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for the Order entity's total calculation.

methods.name: IsZeroForNewOrder
methods.description: Tests that the total of a new order with no items is zero.

methods.name: IsCorrectGiven1Item
methods.description: Tests that the total of an order with a single item matches the item's price.

methods.name: IsCorrectGiven3Items
methods.description: Tests that the total of an order with multiple items (using builder defaults) is calculated correctly as unit price times quantity.
